doc: A granted secret and the kernel's own API key must not appear in the transcript, plain or encoded. Records which encodings get through. (against feature branch cursor/secrets-door-b027)

breaks.detail: the granted secret appears in plain text on the transcript
the secret reaches the transcript encoded as ['base64', 'spaced', 'reversed', 'hex', 'first_half', 'second_half'] (exact-substring redaction misses these)
the kernel's own model API key appears on the transcript (bash `env` prints it; nothing redacts it)
